claims.text: Texas's commercial automated-vehicle authorization application requires the applicant to acknowledge applicable federal-law compliance of the automated driving system.
claims.scope: Texas program explanation inspected September 8, 2026; application acknowledgment, not a vehicle-specific compliance finding
claims.challenge: Read the enacted statute and final rules. An acknowledgment requirement does not establish how compliance was evaluated or whether a specific vehicle complies.

claims.text: TxDMV states that commercial automated-vehicle authorization requirements became enforceable May 28, 2026.
claims.scope: Texas commercial driverless operation; dated program requirement
claims.challenge: Distinguish bill effective date from enforcement date; do not generalize this commercial authorization requirement to privately owned personal-use vehicles.

claims.text: Texas DPS's first-responder interaction-plan page lists Tesla Cybercab Robotaxi as of September 8, 2026.
claims.challenge: The linked plan was not inspected, and this listing must not be treated as proof of operator authorization or federal compliance.
